name: Intermediate Strength · 5 Days
summary: Forge Strength V2 (I-S5): five strength sessions a week for intermediate lifters.
description: Forge Strength V2 program I-S5. Sessions: Squat Strength; Bench Strength; Deadlift + Pull; Upper Volume; Lower Technique. Listed sets are working sets; warm-up sets are separate. Unilateral prescriptions are per side. Rest about 3–5 minutes after primary lifts, 2–3 minutes after secondary compound lifts and 1–2 minutes after accessory work.
progression: Eight-week structured progression. Weeks 1–3 accumulate quality work: primary lifts at 2–3 RIR, secondary lifts at about 3 RIR, and load rises only when every working set reaches the top of the range at the target effort. Week 4 is a planned lower-fatigue week: about 35% fewer working sets at 3–4 RIR, adjustable to your recovery. Weeks 5–7 resume heavier strength work with primary lifts at 1–2 RIR. Week 8 is a reduced-volume performance check: about 30% fewer working sets, primary lifts at 1–3 RIR, no load increase and no required maximal attempts. Load changes follow your recorded performance, never the calendar. If reps are missed, keep or reduce the load.

phases.name: Weeks 1–3 · Accumulation
phases.notes: Accumulate quality work and increase load only where your recorded sets earn it.

exercises.notes: Pull-up or assisted pull-up: use assistance as needed.
Supported split squat: hold a stable support for balance. Dumbbells are optional when appropriate.

phases.name: Week 4 · Lower fatigue
phases.notes: Planned lower-fatigue week: about 35% fewer working sets at 3–4 RIR. The sets shown are the normal baseline. Train normally instead if your recovery is good.

exercises.notes: Pull-up or assisted pull-up: use assistance as needed.
Supported split squat: hold a stable support for balance. Dumbbells are optional when appropriate.

phases.name: Weeks 5–7 · Strength
phases.notes: Resume heavier, strength-focused progression where your recorded sets earn it.

exercises.notes: Pull-up or assisted pull-up: use assistance as needed.
Supported split squat: hold a stable support for balance. Dumbbells are optional when appropriate.

phases.name: Week 8 · Performance check
phases.notes: Reduced-volume performance check: about 30% fewer working sets than shown, at the target effort. No load increase, maximal attempts or grinding reps; no 1RM test is required.

exercises.notes: Pull-up or assisted pull-up: use assistance as needed.
Supported split squat: hold a stable support for balance. Dumbbells are optional when appropriate.
